answer_1.quote: ClinRaGen can produce both medical note-based rationales ... and lab test-based rationales ... enabling SLMs to generate disease diagnoses and structured clinical multimodal rationales.
answer_1.outputs: textual clinical rationales and disease diagnosis predictions

answer_2.quote: Table presents the performance of our model, ClinRaGen, alongside various baselines, using both BLEU and BERTScore on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets.

answer_3.quote: We conduct both LLM comparisons, we use Mistral-7B, LLaMA2-7B, and LLaMA3-8B with five-shot prompting... we use GPT-4 to evaluate 1000 randomly selected samples.

answer_4.quote: For human assessment, 15 professional postgraduates rate 100 samples, achieving moderate intra-class (0.637) and inter-class (0.608) agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators scored each generated rationale on five criteria using a Likert scale from 1 to 5.
